hero.eyebrow: PropTech platform for property managers and residents
hero.subtitle: Connecting property managers and residents in one app. Communication, payments, services — all in one place

items.title: Complex management
items.description: Create and manage residential complexes, buildings, entrances and apartments in a single system. Full control over your property structure.

items.title: Utility billing
items.description: Residents view all charges in the app. Transparent payment history and notifications for new bills.

items.title: Social network
items.description: Internal news feed for residents. Posts, comments, likes — everything for neighbor and management communication.

items.title: Service marketplace
items.description: Residents order apartment services directly from the app: cleaning, repairs, plumbing and other services.

items.title: Dispatch service
items.description: Incident and malfunction reporting. Real-time request status tracking.

items.title: Access rights system
items.description: Flexible role and permission settings for residents, staff, and guests. Full control over access levels.

items.title: Pass management
items.description: Remote creation and management of entry passes to the complex territory. Quick access for guests and couriers.

items.title: Multi-user access
items.description: Multiple residents per apartment. Each family member gets access with their own permissions.

items.title: Property managers
items.description: Full control over residential complexes. Automation of routine processes, instant communication with residents, digital dispatch and analytics.

items.title: Developers
items.description: Digital infrastructure for new properties out of the box. Hand over a ready-made ecosystem to property managers along with the building.

items.title: Residents
items.description: A convenient app for everyday life: utility payments, service requests, neighbor communication, ordering services — all in one place.

problem.title: Building delivered — resident connection lost
problem.lede: The developer invested in product and brand, but after handing over the keys loses the client, the data and the revenue.

items.title: No repeat sales
items.description: A resident bought an apartment — and disappeared. No channel to sell a second one, storage, parking or services.

items.title: Management chaos
items.description: Chats, spreadsheets, calls. Tickets get lost, complaints pile up, the brand suffers.

items.title: No resident data
items.description: Who lives there, what they use, what they would buy — unknown.

items.title: Service earns nothing
items.description: Operations remain a cost center instead of a revenue source.
